title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (9/20): The Beijing–Shanghai High-Speed Railway
note_en: 又…又… links two qualities that hold at the same time: 为了保证铁路又平又稳 "to keep the line both smooth and stable." Where English simply says "smooth and stable," Chinese places 又 before each adjective; it works only with words of the same kind (two adjectives or two verbs), and the pair often sounds more vivid than a plain 和 would, which in any case can't join predicate adjectives.
